approval.d8_reference: No instrument text is stored or released. The mapping records only ESS variable names (fltdpr, flteeff, slprl, wrhpp, fltlnl, enjlf, fltsd, cldgng), category codes (1-4) and administrative codes (7 Refusal, 8 Don't know, 9 No answer), all of which are metadata rather than CES-D item wording. The ESS codebook HTML is gitignored and never committed. Direction handling for the two positively worded items is recorded as a DECLARATION citing the codebook, not as reproduced text. Enforced by test.
approval.d9_reference: Discharged by the ESS release terms. ESS integrated files are published for academic secondary analysis after disclosure control and contain no direct identifiers; idno is a within-country serial number, treated as an opaque string and used only as part of a composite key. Re-identification is prohibited by those terms and is not attempted. Access tier: public_use. Licence obligations (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) are gated separately by require_licence_compatible.
approval.notes: APPROVED SCOPE: non-commercial academic evaluation of the FROZEN model v0.6.0-beta.1 on ESS Round 7 edition 2.3, and academic reporting of aggregate results with the required citation. This approval does NOT extend to: model training or fine-tuning on ESS data (explicitly not authorized in this milestone); commercial reuse (not assumed, and not grantable here - only the licensor can relax the NC clause); ESS Round 11 or any other round (reserved); or any restricted dataset. All six permission flags remain false and are rejected by the schema if flipped.

attribution: European Social Survey (ESS), Round 7, 2014. Data collected by the ESS ERIC and distributed by Sikt - Norwegian Agency for Shared Services in Education and Research.
instrument: CES-D 8-item short form (ESS Round 7 wellbeing module)
notes: Role is new_instrument_multicountry_validation. The frozen DIF capability (SELECTED_MODEL_5A) is architecturally TWO-GROUP - group_code_from_settings reduces settings to (setting > 0) - so a 21-country omnibus contrast is outside its validated region. Cross-country DIF is therefore run as prespecified two-group reference-country contrasts, and labelled with that scope.
publication_use_status: Non-commercial academic evaluation and academic reporting only, per CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Aggregate results may be reported with the required citation. The share-alike clause reaches derived artifacts, so any redistributed derivative carries the same terms. Commercial reuse is NOT assumed and is not authorised here. CES-D item TEXT is not reproduced in the mapping, templates or any committed artifact.
